─ by ElektroStudios
╭───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ Purpose:                                                                          │
│   This application analyzes C# and VB.NET source-code files (*.cs and *.vb) to    │
│   generate a specialized summary of public members that is directly inserted on   │
│   top of each source file through a new '#region' directive, providing a clear    │
│   and updated overview for the publicly accessible members of your API.           │
│                                                                                   │
│   The summary generator supports the following kind of public members:            │
│     - Ctors, properties, fields, events, methods, operators, delegates and enums. │
│                                                                                   │
│   Source files are read and rewritten preserving their exact UTF encoding,        │
│   supporting UTF-8, UTF-16, and UTF-32, with or without a Byte Order Mark (BOM).  │
│                                                                                   │
│   To prevent data loss, files with unknown encodings are automatically skipped.   │
│                                                                                   │
│ [!] Disclaimer:                                                                   │
│   This application is shared 'as-is', without any warranty; Use at your own risk. │
│   Ensure to make a backup of your CS/VB files before using this application.      │
╰───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

Usage:
  CS-VB_PMS_Gen.exe <directory_path> [options]

Mandatory Arguments:
  directory_path    The path to the root directory containing the *.cs or *.vb source-code files to process.

Options:
  -r, --recursive   Recursively process source-code files in all subdirectories.
  -t, --test        Runs the application in Test Mode (dry-run), simulating the entire process without modifying actu
